mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Inspiring Overseer: "Flying. When this creature enters, you gain 1 life and draw a card."
# Event: the compiler's "When this creature enters" (B2a-etb-draw-one). Effect: M21 Witch's
# Cauldron's verified "You gain 1 life and draw a card." (B5c-cost-b-tap-gain-draw), a Seq of
# GAIN_LIFE then DRAW, both for you.
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.GAIN_LIFE, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
            A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, you gain 1 life and draw a card.

mapping.notes: Witch's Cauldron's verified 'You gain 1 life and draw a card.' Seq in the enters trigger. Flying compiles. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/inspiring_overseer_gains_one_and_draws_one.json.
